title: Ruleswright Pack — schemaVersion 1
description: The complete JSON rules + content document the runtime consumes. Closed: unknown fields are validation errors (E-SCHEMA-02). No timestamps or ambient values anywhere — provenance is exactly {theme, seed, knobs} (byte-identical regeneration, FR-17).

economy.description: Optional turn-economy declaration (FR-4): per-turn slot grants. Absent section = documented engine default.

spatial.description: Optional spatial model (FR-11): positions/adjacency/reach for packs that want geometry. Absent = theater of mind; nothing else changes.

equipSlots.description: v1.4 — optional declared equip-slot vocabulary (e.g. ["body", "main-hand", "charm"]). Slot ids are their own vocabulary, like economy slot names: they are NOT artifact ids and do not enter the global-uniqueness namespace (E-DUP-01). Every content.items.<id>.slots entry must resolve here (E-REF-01). Structural defects (empty, duplicate, non-kebab) = E-SCHEMA-01. Absent = the pack declares no equipment slots.

formulas.description: formulaId -> {params?, expr}. v1.4: expressions in this section (and only this section) may read the four equipment variables gear-hp, gear-ac, gear-initiative, gear-armor — each the sum of the matching reserved grant key over every equipped item; 0 when nothing is equipped and 0 wherever unbound (e.g. statblocks). The pack's formula decides what the value does; the engine applies no direction (ascending AC: "10 + gear-ac"; descending AC: "12 - floor(level / 3) - gear-ac"). Every other DSL field keeps its v1.3 vocabulary. v1.5 (FR-11 movement): reserved optional id speed — a movement budget; profiles evaluate it like initiative (CombatantProfile.speed, carried only when formulas.speed is declared). speed is also an engine-derived effect scalar (like hp/ac it shadows a same-named ability inside effect vars): in combat it binds to the actor's profile speed (0 when absent); in out-of-combat item use it binds to this pack's speed formula, else 0. The effect statement move(formula) (registry 13 -> 14) is legal only as the root statement of a non-triggered actions.<id>.effect; nested inside sequence/target/save, or in spells, feats, items' use or triggered actions = E-FORM-02. Its argument must be dice-free (the budget is evaluated at declare time, before cost, and consumes no RNG); a dice argument = E-FORM-02. An effect that references speed at a formula position in a pack with no formulas.speed = E-REF-01; a damage type, condition id, shape or save name spelled speed is not a reference. In a pack without spatial, a move action resolves as a no-op success.

dslString.description: Formula/effect mini-language source; parsed once at load into an AST. Parse failure = E-FORM-01; unknown function = E-FORM-02; unknown ability/save = E-FORM-03.

license.description: Carried and surfaced, never enforced (FR-2, Q7)

stats.description: Name-keyed abilities and named saves. v1.4: no ability or save id may equal a reserved formula variable name — gear-hp, gear-ac, gear-initiative, gear-armor (E-SCHEMA-01) — otherwise a formula name would be ambiguous.

vancian.description: Consumes a BOUND slot of this level; empty slot cannot cast (FR-8)

on.description: Event pattern; presence makes the action reactive (FR-4/FR-13)

tags.description: Coarse categories for condition restricts matching (FR-7) — e.g. ["main"], ["casting"]; matched by restricts patterns "actions.tagged:<tag>" (S-CONTRACT-GAP resolution, builder option A)

turnSlots.description: Slot name -> slots granted per turn (FR-4). When present, action cost.slots keys must resolve here (E-ECON-01). Absent section = documented engine default: 1 of each slot name seen in action costs.

economy.description: Turn-economy declaration (FR-4) — the generic slot/points economy's grant source. Optional; resolves S-CONTRACT-GAP (builder option A).

model.description: grid = square grid, Chebyshev distance (v1.3). hex (v1.5) = axial coordinates {x: q, y: r}, hex distance (|dq|+|dr|+|dq+dr|)/2. Other models are future additive revisions, never silent aliases.

default.description: Melee reach in grid steps (1 = adjacency)

reach.description: Per-id reach overrides are direct siblings of `default` (spatial.html verbatim: "weapons.long-spear": 2). The engine resolves a combatant's reach by combatant/artifact id (`reach[id] ?? reach.default`); dotted artifact paths are a documented v2 seam.

shapes.description: Documented shape set (FR-11): v1 ships single + burst only; cone/line are deferred engine geometry and cannot be declared (E-SPAT-01 if attempted post-validation shape growth).

terrain.description: v1.5 — terrain vocabulary (FR-11): kind id -> {cost} (entering a cell costs this many movement points; plain cells cost 1) or {blocks: true} (never enterable). Cells are placed by the host per fight (startCombat terrain), never by the pack.

spatial.description: The spatial model (spatial.html verbatim): {model: 'grid' | 'hex', reach: {default, <label>: n}, shapes?, terrain?}. Positions are host-declared per combatant; the engine never invents a grid.

armorCasting.description: Armor types in which this class may cast — pack data (FR-9)

actions.description: v1.2 — action ids a character of this class may declare in combat (FR-16 parity with statblock actions); each must be a key of the pack's actions map (E-REF-01)

caps.description: classId -> max level; classic level-cap curve (FR-6). Unknown classId = E-REF-02

size.description: Spatial size class (FR-11): melee adjacency/reach checks are computed between positions; size does not affect adjacency in v1 (documented) — optional, defaults to medium

ability.description: Must name an ability in stats.abilities

shape.description: v1 shapes only; cone/line deferred as engine geometry (FR-11)

tags.description: Categories for restricts matching (FR-7) — spells participate in tag checks through the same matcher as actions (FR-9)

restricts.description: Action tag patterns blocked while active — the condition's teeth (FR-7). Patterns "actions.tagged:<tag>" must reference a tag declared on at least one action or spell (E-REF-01)

slots.description: v1.4 — the declared equip slots this item MAY be equipped into; one equip places it in exactly one of them. Presence makes the item equippable. Each id must resolve in the root equipSlots (E-REF-01)

armor.description: The armor marker (CA-EG3); exposed to formulas as gear-armor

grants.description: v1.4 — grant key -> integer, applied while the item is equipped. No dice (FR-1 determinism). Keys: (1) an ability id or a save id — the value is ADDED to that stat, never a replacement; a key naming both an ability and a save adds to both. (2) a reserved key hp | ac | initiative | armor — summed over every equipped item and exposed ONLY to formulas entries as gear-hp | gear-ac | gear-initiative | gear-armor (0 when nothing is equipped); the pack's formula decides direction, the engine adds nothing on its own. Armor marker: an item is armor iff its grants include the key armor, whose value must be an integer >= 1. Any other key is a dangling reference (E-REF-01); a non-integer value or armor < 1 is structural (E-SCHEMA-01)

use.description: v1.4 — effect-DSL string (same grammar actions and spells use; e.g. "heal(2 + vigor)"), parsed once at load. Presence makes the item consumable; one use consumes one unit. Parse failure = E-FORM-01; unknown function = E-FORM-02; unknown ability/save = E-FORM-03

byDefense.description: defenseValue -> toHit; keys are pack convention (descending-AC = keys "2".."9"). The engine never knows (FR-3)

attackBonus.description: Ascending-AC alternative. XOR with attackTable — exactly one convention per class

additionalProperties.description: Per-level save values; names must exist in stats.saves; length = max level
Vancian slots per class level, indexed by spell level (FR-8)

attackTable.description: Reference to a progression attack table

actions.description: Action ids — same machinery as characters (FR-16)

value.description: Scalar, object, or reference to another table (nested); depth bounded at load (E-TBL-01)
